summary.text: Richard West is a Republican state representative from New Melle, Missouri, who represents House District 102 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against David Rogers.
His career includes work as a law enforcement officer, criminal investigator and international police advisor.

paragraphs.text: West was born in St. Louis, Missouri, lives in New Melle, and graduated from Bishop DuBourg High School in 1985.
His career experience includes working as a law enforcement officer, criminal investigator and international police advisor, and owning a business.
West won election to Missouri House District 63 in 2020, then won District 102 in 2022 and again in 2024, when he defeated Alex Hissong.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Administration and Accounts, where he is vice chair, Local Government, and the Joint Committee on Public Employee Retirement.
